sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-derived intermediate is the descending color-score table; for the selected case it is [[9, 6], [4, 2], [1, 1]].
sequential_dependency.step_a: For each nonzero input color, build its binary mask, count 4-connected objects, form [color,count] pairs, and sort those pairs by count descending.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Read that ordered score table, choose the largest score as output width, and render one right-aligned colored run of exactly each score length.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step B consumes both the order and exact numeric scores from Step A. Replacing component scores with colored-cell scores yields [[4, 18], [1, 16], [9, 6]], changing row order, width, and run lengths, so the protected final output changes.
